tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows smooth monotone concavity over u_now but provides almost no s_grad variation. The documented sink-coupled siphon candidates and their open-branch terms therefore remain ambiguous; the open-branch discriminating probe is the targeted, lowest-cost available measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the 2-layer inland-hub siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows vary only u_now; s_grad spans just 0.018, so sink inhibition and the open-branch contribution are not identifiable.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a single-factor Michaelis-Menten curve now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It could explain the observed concavity, but the supplied mechanism notes warn it fails when s_grad varies; the current narrow gradient range cannot distinguish it from inhibited siphon mechanisms.
The rows do not indicate memory-ODE dynamics, and this batch is aimed at trajectory identification rather than the present branch ambiguity.
It is explicitly irrelevant to identifying the candidate response mechanisms.
